lines.t: The Sun Dips Low
drums of heaven they start to play the song of the lamb it lights the way
oh rise oh rise let the sound unfold the story sung a tale retold
Oh, dance to the song of the Lamb
Oh, dance, spin through the rhythms, take a chance
Hallelujah
Feel the sway
The song of the Lamb will lead today
A breeze that whispers through the trees
It hums a hymn upon the sea
Stars like notes in the velvet sky
The song of the lamb will never die
Step by step the earth replies
With every heartbeat it multiplies
Male voice calls, female voice repeats
Together they rise, their harmony sweet
Dance to the song of the land
Oh, dance, spin through the rhythms, take a chance
Hallelujah, feel the sway, the song of the Lamb will lead today.
Thank you.
